name: Biomedical Language Understanding Evaluation (BLUE)
description: A benchmark consisting of five tasks with ten datasets covering biomedical and clinical texts to facilitate research in pre-training language representations in biomedicine. It evaluates models like BERT and ELMo on diverse biomedical NLP tasks.
reputation: BLUE is a widely cited early benchmark for biomedical and clinical NLP and helped standardize evaluation across multiple biomedical text tasks.
notes: Includes datasets of varying sizes and difficulties; provides pre-trained models and code publicly.
